# Traefik — servlet-mapping

App at / with the Vaadin servlet bound to /ui/*. /HILLA/* (Hilla push) and /connect/* (browser-callables) stay at the context root whatever the mapping is, so two routers strip the /ui prefix for them at an explicit priority above the catch-all, which carries /ui/* and the root-level static resources.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# App at /, with the Vaadin servlet bound to /ui/* instead of the root.
#
# Hilla does not follow vaadin.url-mapping: /HILLA/* (its push endpoint) and
# /connect/* (browser-callables) stay at the context root whatever the Vaadin
# servlet is mapped to, while the browser asks for them under /ui. So those two
# paths have to be stripped back to the root, and they have to win over the
# catch-all. See vaadin/hilla#289.
#
# Traefik resolves ties by rule length, which would already favour the Hilla
# rules here, but the priorities are written out rather than relied upon: a
# subtly wrong order produces a working app with a dead Hilla Flux, which is
# only caught when the tests run with it.websocket=true.
http:
  routers:
    hilla-push:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/HILLA/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    hilla-connect:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/connect/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    # Everything else reaches the backend untouched: /ui/* for the Vaadin
    # servlet (including /ui/VAADIN/push), and the root-level resources that
    # stay at the root whatever the mapping is — /VAADIN/*, /sw.js,
    # /styles.css, /manifest.webmanifest, /icons/*, /images/*, /test-redirect.
    root:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 1
      middlewares:
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    strip-ui:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/ui"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
